title: 第7章 交易第8章 去镇上第9章 去考察
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
“你来做什么！”张管家气急败坏。
“我来干什么你不知道？”李管家完全不慌，慢悠悠的说。
“现在谈到多少了？”李管家问林鹤清，他手下的府丁不知道从哪搞来一张凳子，他还坐下了。
“什么？”林鹤清装傻。
“你和他，”李管家指向张管家，“谈的那个东西，他说多少银子卖给他？”
“他说二十两，我不卖”，林鹤清说完李管家看张管家眼神都不对了。
“那你要多少？”李管家说。
“一千两，不然就送给县太爷”，小孩还是咕噜话，不松口。
“成……”李管家大气。
“不成，我先来的，我一千两买”，张管家急了，要是任务没完成，回去少不了一顿骂。
“一千一百两”，李管家手上还多了一杯茶。
“一千两百两”，张管家这个亏是吃不下的。
“一千三百两”，李管家喝了口水。
“一千四百两，再加我就不要了”，张管家眼球充血。
“一千四百五十两，这是我最后的价钱”，李管家才不会被他威胁。
“一千四百六十两！！”王管家咬牙切齿。
“人参是你的了。”李管家淡定道。
张管家气的说不出话来。
半晌，王管家才对林鹤清说，“把东西拿过来”。
“好”，林鹤清跑进茅草屋里，假装从箱子里，其实是从空间里拿出人参来，用之前包没泡水人参的布把它包了起来。

“嗯，给你”，林鹤清递给张管家，“我的银子在哪，我还要娶媳妇呢”。
“少不了你的”，张管家小心接过人参，递给后面的人，从袖子里掏出银票，数了十四张一百两的、一张五十两的银票，还有十两的银锭，递给林鹤清，“都在这了”。
回头打开那布包，确认这东西就是自己想要的，就气冲冲地离开了。
留下李管家还在凳子上坐着喝茶，“这银票？”林鹤清看向李管家。
“整个大卫王朝都能兑银子，数量没错”，李管家回道。
“我想和您谈一笔交易”，林鹤清眼睛直视着对方，小声说，不想让别人听见。
“你说”，李管家眼里有了一丝感兴趣。
“我现在有一千四百两，我要给一百两给村长，让他给村民们，感谢他们帮我安葬我父母。
我想给你五百两，这五百两就是让你在我十五岁之前保护我的安全，不让别人把我绑了伤了，也不能偷抢我的钱。
请一个先生教我认字读书，三个月就行，三个月不管我学到哪里都可以结束。
帮我在镇上找个房子住八年，买房子的银子我自己出，太贵了我也可以租，不超过三百两的都行。
然后四百两的银票帮我换成银子，十两五两还有一两的都要。
五十的银票我留着防身。
剩下一百两我送给您，成么？”林鹤清小声说。
content_en:
"What are you doing!" Butler Zhang was furious.
"You don't know what I'm here for?" Butler Li said slowly without panicking at all.
"How much have we talked about now?" Butler Li asked Lin Heqing. His servant got a stool from nowhere, and he sat down.
"What?" Lin Heqing pretended to be stupid.
"You and him," Butler Li pointed to Butler Zhang, "that thing you were talking about, how much money did he say it would cost to sell it to him?"
"He said twenty taels, but I won't sell it." After Lin Heqing said this, Butler Li looked at Butler Zhang and his eyes were wrong.
"Then how much do you want?" Butler Li said.
"One thousand taels, or I will give it to the county magistrate." The child still muttered and did not let go.
"Sure..." Butler Li said enthusiastically.
"No, I was here first. I bought it for one thousand taels." Butler Zhang was anxious. If the task was not completed, he would be scolded when he returned.
"One thousand one hundred taels", Butler Li had an extra cup of tea in his hand.
"One thousand two hundred taels", Butler Zhang couldn't bear this loss.
"One thousand three hundred taels", Butler Li took a sip of water.
"One thousand four hundred taels, I won't take any more." Butler Zhang's eyes were bloodshot.
"One thousand four hundred and fifty taels, this is my last price." Butler Li would not be threatened by him.
"One thousand four hundred and sixty taels!!" Steward Wang gritted his teeth.
"The ginseng is yours." Butler Li said calmly.
Butler Zhang was so angry that he couldn't speak.
After a long while, Butler Wang said to Lin Heqing, "Bring the things here."
"Okay", Lin Heqing ran into the thatched house, pretended to take out the ginseng from the box, but actually took it out of the space, and wrapped it in the cloth that had not been soaked in water before.
"Well, here it is," Lin Heqing handed it to Butler Zhang, "Where is my money? I still want to get a wife."
"It's indispensable for you." Butler Zhang carefully took the ginseng and handed it to the person behind him. He took out the banknotes from his sleeve, counted fourteen 100-tael banknotes, one 50-tael banknote, and ten taels of silver ingots, and handed them to Lin Heqing, "They're all here."
He turned around and opened the cloth bag, confirmed that it was what he wanted, and left angrily.
Butler Li was still sitting on the stool drinking tea. "This bank note?" Lin Heqing looked at Butler Li.
"The entire Davidic dynasty can redeem silver, and the amount is correct," Butler Li replied.
"I want to negotiate a deal with you," Lin Heqing looked directly at the other person and whispered, not wanting others to hear.
"Say." Butler Li had a hint of interest in his eyes.
"I have one thousand four hundred taels now, and I want to give one hundred taels to the village chief so that he can give it to the villagers to thank them for helping me bury my parents.
I want to give you five hundred taels. These five hundred taels are so that you can protect my safety until I am fifteen years old. You will not let others tie me up or hurt me, and you will not be able to steal my money.
I asked a gentleman to teach me how to read and read. Three months would be enough. No matter where I learned, I could finish in three months.
Help me find a house to live in the town for eight years. I will pay for the house myself. If it is too expensive, I can rent it, no more than three hundred taels.
Then I exchanged four hundred taels of silver notes for silver, and asked for 10 taels, 50 taels, and one tael.
I kept the fifty-fifty banknote for self-defense.
I'll give you the remaining one hundred taels, okay? Lin Heqing said softly.
